$comment: Birth numbering: backlog.cardNumbering.numberAtBirth.enabled on|off (WE_NUMBER_AT_BIRTH); remote best-effort|required (WE_CARD_NUMBERING_REMOTE). Standard -> platform backlog -> tool -> environment, with per-leaf provenance logged. Best-effort falls back to hash naming on unknown remote evidence; required refuses. Remote claims are atomic and create-only; burned numbers are never reused.
